description:
Job location: Job location: Bucharest, Brasov, Cluj-Napoca, Iasi, Timisoara, Targu Mures | Hybrid | 09:00–18:00

Please note:

During the initial onboarding period, employees are expected to work from the office up to 5 days per week for approximately 6 months, depending on business and project requirements.

For candidates located in other cities from Romania different for the below ones, we can offer greater flexibility, including a remote working arrangement, subject to business and project needs.

We have opportunities with different start dates. Some roles are available for an immediate start, while others are planned to start in January 2027.


Role summary:

Join our Finance team and contribute to key financial operations activities within the Order to Cash (OTC) process, ensuring accurate billing, cash collection, and customer account management.

We are open to candidates with minimal finance previous experience, as well as finance professionals looking to further develop their expertise.


Your mission:

Collections activity

 

  • Perform day-to-day billing, collections, and customer account management activities;
  • Follow up on customer accounts in line with accounts receivable procedures through both email and phone communication;
  • Handle inbound and outbound calls with customers to resolve payment-related queries, overdue balances, and account discrepancies;
  • Review financial information and help maintain accurate customer account data;
  • Identify errors and support the implementation of corrective actions;
  • Participate actively in training and continuously develop your knowledge of Order to Cash processes..



Required Qualifications:


  • Advanced Dutch & English language skills;
  • High school diploma mandatory;
  • For experienced-level consideration, at least 1 year of relevant professional experience;
  • Ability to understand finance processes and apply logical thinking to daily activities.

 


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree;
  • Previous experience in Finance & Accounting, Order to Cash, Billing, Accounts Receivable, or Collections;
  • Motivation to learn and develop within a finance operations environment.

 


Employee Benefits – Be well, work well, live well

 

  • Private medical and dental coverage through Regina Maria.
  • Flexible benefits package via Benefit Online, including vouchers, transportation, wellness, and cultural activities.
  • 23 vacation days, with additional days awarded through our loyalty program.
  • Additional private pension plan starting from the second month of employment.
  • Access to extensive learning, training, and career development opportunities.
  • Well-being support, including psychological counseling and premium wellness apps.
  • Life insurance coverage for you and your loved ones.
  • Flexible working hours, depending on project requirements.
